subject: botany
question_text: Glycine and alanine differ with respect to one substituent on the carbon. What are the other common groups?

verification.note: Sourced from the Sri Chaitanya Junior Botany Fastrack, Chapter 10 Biomolecules, book p.26, VSAQ 5. The book answers 'NH2, H, COOH'; the same three groups are given here, with the alpha-carbon named and the differing R group stated, because the question carries two marks. Only one source book is held for botany — the TSBIE Basic Learning Material in hand is physics-only and no botany board paper is in the corpus — so the two-book union check and the board-paper back-test are both structurally impossible for this card, not merely unrun; 'not checked' here means exactly that, never 'checked and clean'. The mark split is a claim until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it; the question itself is sourced, not invented.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: The three common groups
lines: Every amino acid has four groups on its
steps.why: The alpha-carbon of any amino acid carries four groups. Three of them are the same in every amino acid, so any two amino acids can differ only in the fourth.
common_mistakes: Listing only –NH₂ and –COOH. The hydrogen atom on the alpha-carbon is the third common group.
Naming the R group as common. That is the one that differs.
steps.memory_tip: Four groups on the alpha-carbon: three are fixed, only R changes.
steps.margin_note: List the three with their formulas. A bare list earns the mark.

steps.label: The group that differs
lines: The fourth group is the variable R group,
It is a hydrogen atom in glycine and a
steps.why: Naming what differs shows the three common groups were not guessed. Glycine is the simplest amino acid because its R group is only a hydrogen atom.
common_mistakes: Writing that alanine has R = –H. Alanine has the methyl group –CH₃.
Writing 'CH₃ group' without saying it is the R group or side chain.
steps.memory_tip: Glycine is the smallest: its side chain is one hydrogen atom. Alanine adds a methyl group.
steps.margin_note: One boxed line with both R groups completes the answer.

insider_note: The question says 'other common groups', so the answer must be the three shared ones. State the differing R group as well to show the count of four.
